entities.summary: Bosnian Church, a political institution in Bosnia and Herzegovina during Medieval Bosnian Kingdom (1180–1250). Grew from Slavic Settlement and Early Banate. Led to the emergence of Ban Kulin's Charter — earliest Bosnian state document and Bogomil Heresy and the Bosnian Church.
